title: Island medicine ferry-delay contact sheet
summary: A continuity sheet for island or coastal households when ferries, pharmacies, clinics, or couriers are delayed and medicine supply may run short.
content: Core sequence: 1) List medicines by person, days remaining, storage needs, prescriber, pharmacy, and island or mainland backup contact. 2) Start calls early when weather, strikes, ferry changes, or holidays threaten the normal refill path. 3) Ask for professional advice before substituting, splitting, stopping, or changing any medicine. 4) Record every call result with date, name, and next promised action.
